hotels.title: Award-Winning New Zealand Escape near Queenstown with NZ$100 Spa Credit & Daily Free-Flow Sparkling Wine
hotels.description: Gibbston Valley Lodge & Spa sits in a natural amphitheatre of schist rock and pinot noir vines, where the terrain produces some of New Zealand's most celebrated cool-climate wines. This MICHELIN Key property boasts 24 private villas looking out over the working vines and The Lodge restaurant that pairs its Central Otago produce with the property's own label wine. Start each morning with free-flow Gibbston Valley Méthode Traditionnelle at the Bubbles Bar, sipping the estate's own sparkling, before heading underground on an included cave wine tour where the valleys tunnels reveal the story behind the vines above. Named New Zealand's Best Resort Spa by the World Spa Awards for six years running, the spa draws on the surrounding vineyard for treatments that work with the restorative properties of the vine. As outdoor hot tubs and a sauna sit against a backdrop of open sky, this is the perfect place to relax.
